services.name: How do you spot a manatee?
services.desc: Nestled along the serene waters of the St. Johns River, one of Florida’s most enchanting residents glides gracefully beneath the surface - the beloved manatee! Known for their gentle nature and distinctive appearance, these marine mammals have found a home in the St. Johns River. This creates a unique opportunity for locals and visitors to witness their calming presence. As the slow-moving current winds its way through the landscapes, manatees become a key part of the river’s narrative. Join us in exploring the wonder of manatees along the St. Johns River!
